name: vector
description: The <vector> library provides the std::vector container, a dynamic array that can resize itself automatically when elements are inserted or removed.

vector.desc: A sequence container that encapsulates dynamic size arrays.

push_back.desc: Adds an element to the end of the vector.

pop_back.desc: Removes the last element from the vector.

size.desc: Returns the number of elements in the vector.

capacity.desc: Returns the number of elements that can be held in currently allocated storage.

empty.desc: Checks whether the vector is empty.

resize.desc: Changes the number of elements stored in the vector.

clear.desc: Removes all elements from the vector.

at.desc: Accesses an element at a specified index with bounds checking.

operator[].desc: Accesses an element at a specified index without bounds checking.

begin.desc: Returns an iterator to the first element of the vector.

end.desc: Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the vector.
